channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 46 new entries
item.description:
46 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, metabolomics, histology / imaging-only, genomics, and 3 more.

soDGVAE
Conditional graph attention variational autoencoder that harmonizes and aligns multi-source spatial transcriptomics data.

Inferring somatic copy number aberrations from spatial transcriptomics data to study early cancer development
Pipeline that infers and spatially maps somatic copy number aberration-defined cell populations from Xenium data.

smoothclust
Spatial-smoothing clustering workflow plus boundary-density metric summarizing spatial domain organization.

ALHENA
H&E encoder distilled from transcriptomic models that predicts gene expression and cell types from histology alone.

DeepMAST
Evidence-governed multi-agent AI system that runs spatial transcriptomics workflows and prioritizes candidate targets.

PatHoST
Weakly supervised model that reconstructs pathogen spatial distributions from host-only spatial transcriptomes.

Live-ST
Electroporation-based spatial barcoding technology enabling repeated, non-destructive spatial transcriptomics in living tissue.

Kontext
Kernel-based framework identifying spatial domains grounded in ligand-receptor cell-cell communication patterns.

SpaCut
Deep learning framework fusing transcript and morphology features for accurate subcellular spatial transcriptomics cell segmentation.

Decoder-FFPE-seq
Dendrimeric DNA barcoding assay for sensitive, genome-wide, single-cell spatial transcriptomics on FFPE tissue.

DR-GEM
Self-supervised meta-algorithm improving single-cell/spatial embeddings by recovering rare cell types and noise filtering.

RIF
Graph neural network framework identifying fine-grained, interpretable spatial domains across spatial transcriptomics platforms.

NicheCorr
Statistical procedure detecting niche-specific gene co-expression changes and ligand-receptor signaling in spatial transcriptomics.

GeneCMamba
Autoregressive state-space model predicting spatial gene expression tokens from H&E histology images.

SpaceDX
Attention-based spatial weighting framework that jointly tests and localizes differential expression across subjects.

PDA/COF LACFI-MSI platform
Novel polydopamine/COF composite substrate boosts sensitivity of laser ablation carbon fiber ionization mass spectrometry imaging.

Automated Tissue Classification and Candidate Biomarker Feature Extraction in Mass Spectrometry Imaging Based on Interpretable Deep Learning Algorithm
CNN-based pipeline with Grad-CAM/SHAP classifies MSI tissue layers and extracts discriminative spectral features.

TAPT-DFTA matrix
Fluorinated triazine COF matrix integrates PFOS adsorption and ionization for ultrasensitive MALDI tissue imaging.

Spatialsnake
Snakemake-based workflow for analysing processed spatial transcriptomics data across multiple platforms.

ATLAS
Encodes learned transcriptional signatures in situ via oligo probes to map cell types at atlas scale.

Spatialformer
Transformer-based spatial representation learning model for single-cell spatial transcriptomics data.

merfisheyes
Next.js website for visualizing MERFISH spatial transcriptomics data.

AgaeSMO
Graph attention autoencoder integrates paired and unpaired spatial multi-omics including H&E images for domain delineation.

STID
Seurat/Python-based standardized framework for infection-associated niche identification and host-pathogen spatial analysis.

REBOSEP
Workflow detecting tissue boundaries in spatial transcriptomics and quantifying gene expression changes relative to boundary distance.

Evaluation of the nano Liquid Chromatography coupled with Zeno TOF 7600 Mass Spectrometer for Cell Type-Resolved Spatial Proteomics
Combines image-guided laser capture microdissection with nanoLC-Zeno TOF DIA-MS for cell type-resolved spatial proteomics.

Enabling High-Throughput Tissue Sectioning for Robust Lipid Mass Spectrometry Imaging
Automated tissue processing integrated with MALDI-MSI and serial two-photon tomography for reproducible lipid imaging.

Michler's Ketone matrix
Novel negative-ion MALDI matrix improving amino acid detection and spatial imaging in tissue.

Quadruple Boronic Acid-Functionalized Lanthanide MOFs Enable Deep and Unbiased Spatial Proteomics from Ultra-Trace Laser-Captured Microtissues
Boronic-acid MOF-based sample prep workflow boosts protein capture and depth from laser-captured microtissue sections.

Thyra
Memory-bounded Python library streaming MSI data directly into SpatialData/Zarr for scverse-compatible analysis.

Ionic Solid Matrix (ISM) + LTE
Ionic solid matrices with low-temperature evaporation improve MALDI-MSI sensitivity for small metabolites.

SpatialZoomer
Spectral graph method extracting multi-scale spatial transcriptomic features at single-cell, niche and domain scales via low-pass filtering.

Benchmarking segmentation methods for spatial transcriptomics
Benchmarks 11 segmentation methods across 15 datasets and 5 platforms with new biologically informed evaluation metrics.

HetAnn
Graph attention network jointly embeds spatial transcriptomics and scRNA-seq data for cell type annotation.

DIaS
Disentangles spatial, intrinsic and harmonized signals in spatial transcriptomics and hyperspectral imaging using Gaussian-process-based embeddings.

SDESE
Joint spatial and genetic fine-mapping method linking GWAS risk loci to spatial transcriptomic neuroanatomical niches.

X-SPEAR
Framework for designing and auditing Xenium gene panels using a Boolean rule-based marker-selection method and off-target checks.

CPMsi
Pipeline that aligns, reduces and integrates large multi-omics MSI datasets into consensus spectra across tissue sections.

BiNVaST
Dual-branch VAE using synthetic data and reference integration for cell typing across high-resolution spatial platforms.

StarTrak
Neural network framework reconstructing cell lineage and tumor migration from somatic mutations in spatial omics data.

SpacePath
Scores pathways across tissue and groups unannotated ions into de novo molecular families in spatial MSI data.

CellBridge
Contrastive model pretrained on paired H&E and spatial profiles predicts cell types from pathology images.

CoSMIM
Represents cell niches via multi-scale gene covariance fusion to identify spatial domains without training.

SPATNIC
VAE trained on H&E-matched Xenium labels to classify cancer vs normal cells across spatial and single-cell platforms.

SPInfer
Workflow fine-tuning Cellpose-SAM foundation model for accurate brain tissue cell segmentation in spatial proteomics.

Probabilistic uncertainty in virtual spatial transcriptomics from histology is largely redundant with the predicted mean
Benchmarks uncertainty-estimation methods for histology-based virtual spatial transcriptomics, finding uncertainty largely redundant with predicted mean.
